about.subtitle: Who I am and what I offer
about.description: I'm not just a coder — I'm a Solution Architect. My work is transforming design into living, responsive, and performant products. Focus on component architecture (CDD), clean state management, and creating the perfect UX. In one year of frontend development, I have implemented projects from landing pages to Web3 wallets, always following principles of clean code and scalability.

workExperience.description: 1 year in frontend development. Implemented projects from presentation landing pages to complex Web3 applications (wallets, DeFi platforms, token generators). Worked with e-commerce integrations, SPA applications, and Telegram Mini Apps.

experience.approachTitle: My experience and approach to work
experience.philosophyTitle: My philosophy — I am a practitioner
experience.approachDescription1: Over the past year, I have actively worked on freelancing and implemented various projects: from presentation landing pages to complex Web3 applications (DeFi, crypto wallets) and Telegram Mini Apps.
experience.philosophyDescription1: I may not remember a term from a textbook, but I always understand how and why code works. I don't start coding until I have thought through the architecture of the future project. This is my way of immediately laying a reliable foundation and avoiding problems in the future.
experience.philosophyDescription2: I am (in a good sense) meticulous and pedantic. I genuinely love clean, understandable code that is easy to maintain. I don't deliver work until I personally am 100% sure that everything is tested and works like a clock.
experience.philosophyDescription3: Although my focus is frontend, I understand how the backend works (worked with Next.js and Node.js), which helps me see the entire project picture as a whole. I continue to practice every day to make my work faster and better.
